raw:
[
  {
    "operation": "etymology",
    "chain": "astro (Greek astron = star) + world (Old English weorold = age of man); compound = star-age",
    "reading": "The age or realm of stars, a cosmic epoch rather than a place",
    "languages": ["grc", "en", "ang"],
    "source": "Liddell & Scott, Greek-English Lexicon; Bosworth-Toller, Anglo-Saxon Dictionary",
    "confidence": 0.8
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "as + tro + world; 'as' (like) + 'trow' (Middle English = to believe) + 'orld' (hidden 'old')",
    "reading": "As one believes the old world — faith shapes the perceived cosmos",
    "languages": ["en", "enm"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "astro (fr. 'astre' = star) + world → 'astre' + 'world' → 'astre' sounds like 'aître' (enclosure, churchyard)",
    "reading": "A star-enclosure: a sacred precinct where celestial and earthly meet",
    "languages": ["fr", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Astroworld → 'row' + 'world' + 'st' → 'strow' (archaic = to scatter) + 'orld'",
    "reading": "Scattering the world's order; a dispersal of cosmic structure into chaos",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "notariqon",
    "chain": "A-S-T-R-O-W-O-R-L-D → A (alpha) S (sigma) T (tau) R (rho) O (omicron) W (double-u) O (omicron) R (rho) L (lambda) D (delta)",
    "reading": "Alpha to delta: a star's journey from beginning to end, a cosmic alphabet",
    "languages": ["grc", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "A = beginning, S = serpent, T = cross, R = sun, O = circle, W = double V, O = circle, R = sun, L = measure, D = door",
    "reading": "Beginning serpent-cross, sun-circle, double-v, circle-sun, measure-door: a ritual path of transformation",
    "languages": ["en", "la"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.2
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "A=1, S=19, T=20, R=18, O=15, W=23, O=15, R=18, L=12, D=4 → sum = 145; 1+4+5=10; 1+0=1",
    "reading": "Reduces to 1 — the monad, the single star from which all worlds emanate",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",
    "chain": "astro + world → 'astral' + 'whorl' (spiral) — 'world' as 'whorl' (turning pattern)",
    "reading": "A starry spiral: the galaxy's turning dance, a cosmic vortex",
    "languages": ["en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  }
]
